1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially reduce embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __without prior destructive processing of the embryo__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation is performed for a duration of less than one hour__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without prior cold treatment__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from cell wall degrading enzymes that are applied after collection of the shed cellular material__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a method that preserves embryo viability__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying magnetic separation__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the stage prior to radicle emergence__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (d) __in a quiescent state__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without embryo destruction__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __and is performed prior to germination of the embryo__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA extracted from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after genotype-based selection__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and performed without destroying the embryo__.
